entities.name: LpxD (A0KHH3)
observations: Exact sequence match to reviewed UniProt A0KHH3 from Aeromonas hydrophila; 339 aa, 100% identity and coverage.
EC 2.3.1.191; catalyzes N-acylation of UDP-3-O-acylglucosamine using 3-hydroxyacyl-ACP, in lipid A biosynthesis.
Pfam matches LpxD family PF04613 and hexapeptide-repeat acyltransferase family.

entities.name: LpxD N-acylation
observations: EC 2.3.1.191; the reaction adds a second 3-hydroxyacyl group to the glucosamine amino group during lipid A precursor synthesis.
